title: reject scenario's selection assert is dead code (sel_node != -1 && sel_pipe != -1 is unreachable)
detail: sel_node and sel_pipe are mutually exclusive by construction, so the && condition can never fire; the scenario's promised 'rejected draw must not change the selection' pin is vacuous (the no-command half via the expected stream is real).
recommended_fix: Change && to || (fail if either became selected), or preset a selection and assert it survives the rejected draw.

title: pan scenario scripts an event order poll_touch never emits; its 'no selection changes' assert is vacuous
detail: The live adapter emits Touch_Release at the 1->2 transition and nothing at 2->0 lift, so scripted Press->Pan->Pan->Release is impossible live; with no preset selection, the lift's Select -> click_select selection-clear is unobservable.
recommended_fix: Script the live order (Press, Release, Pan, Pan), preset sel_pipe, and assert it survives; or drop the lift release and the 'no selection changes' comment claim.

title: Press_Anchor latch-reset intent (new in the fix) is asserted nowhere
detail: esc_press's release lands 12 tiles from the press (moved > 6px), so press_swallowed is never consulted and commit_draw runs regardless; Parity_Run captures no press_swallowed. Deleting Press_Anchor (mouse.odin:170,226 + executor) changes no test outcome.
recommended_fix: Add a scenario with a same-frame ESC+press then a NON-moved release asserting the click-select still runs, or capture press_swallowed in Parity_Run and assert it.

title: UI-swallow hook paths untested: the harness wires only on_right_click; on_ui_press/on_ui_release are always nil
evidence:
ictx.sel_class = sel_class
	ictx.placing = -1
	ictx.on_right_click = on_right_click
--- run_input_parity: `if sc.name == "input_parity_right_click" || sc.name == "input_parity_right_x" { hook = parity_right_click_effect }`
--- app/input/mouse.odin:185: `ui = inp.on_ui_press(inp.user, inp, left_press)` and app/input/touch.odin:46-50: `if inp.on_ui_press != nil { ui = inp.on_ui_press(inp.user, inp, v.pos) } if ui { inp.press_swallowed = true }`
detail: With on_ui_press nil in every scenario, the mouse ui=true swallow branch, the new touch W3 swallow, phase2_blocked's ui disjunct, and release_ui_hit's app-UI half never execute — the popover/QoS swallow transcription has zero coverage.
recommended_fix: Let drive_parity accept on_ui_press/on_ui_release stubs (true inside a fixed rect) and add swallowed-press scenarios: no drag start, no release re-select, phase-2 keys suppressed.

title: phase2_blocked pinned on only its has_right disjunct — tray-swallowed-press and placement-press suppression untested
evidence:
phase2_blocked := has_right || (has_left && (ui || tray_hit || placing_eff >= 0))
--- the only suppression pin (harness/parity.odin right_x):
			evs(inp.Mouse_Press{pos = mid01, button = .Right}, inp.Key_Press{key = .X}),
detail: right_x is the sole same-frame phase-2 suppression scenario. No scenario pairs a tray-chip press or a placement left-press with a same-frame X/U/E/S/B key, so the tray_hit and placing_eff disjuncts of the B1 fix can regress undetected.
recommended_fix: Add scenarios [tray chip press + X] and [placement-press + X] asserting no demolish/command is produced on those frames.

title: pad Start -> Toggle_Pause mapping unpinned; pause toggle-back (Paused -> Run) boundary untested
evidence:
case .Start:
			append(out, Intent(Toggle_Pause{}))
--- the only pause pin is mouse-only, one-way (harness/parity.odin input_parity_pause):
		mouse = frames(
			evs(inp.Key_Press{key = .P}),
		),
and its assert: `if r, ok := find(runs, devs, .Mouse); ok && r.mode != .Paused {`
detail: No scenario scripts a pad Start button (grep of harness/parity.odin finds no Start), and no second toggle frame proves the Paused -> Run return; a dropped Start case or a stuck one-way toggle passes the suite.
recommended_fix: Add a pad Start scenario asserting mode == .Paused, and a two-press scenario asserting the flip back to .Run.

title: pad_alive Confirm guard (new in the fix) never exercised; pad_step dead-slot skip unpinned
detail: No scenario kills the node under the pad cursor before Confirm, and every pad scenario runs with all three fixture nodes alive — the new demolished-cursor guard and the dead-slot scan/wrap paths have zero coverage.
recommended_fix: Add a scenario that demolishes the cursor's node before pad A (assert no command/cursor move), and a cursor step that skips a dead slot.

title: Placement release gates unpinned: swallowed arm-press release, moved>6 release, chip toggle-cancel, invalid-tile no-op
evidence:
mouse = frames(
			evs(inp.Mouse_Press{pos = chip_router, button = .Left}),
			evs(inp.Mouse_Press{pos = place_pos, button = .Left}),
			evs(inp.Mouse_Release{pos = place_pos, button = .Left}),
		),
--- app/input/exec.odin:115: `case Place_Release:` ... `if !inp.press_swallowed { moved := rl.Vector2Distance(v.pos, inp.press) > 6 ...`
--- exec.odin:81: `inp.placing = (inp.placing == v.type_idx) ? -1 : v.type_idx`
detail: The place scenario never releases the arm press (press_swallowed gate), never drags past 6px (moved gate), never re-presses the router chip (toggle-cancel), and never releases on a rejected tile (silent no-command path) — four gates unpinned.
recommended_fix: Extend placement scenarios: release the arm press (no router placed), a dragged placement release, a chip re-press cancel, and an invalid-tile release asserting no command.

title: click_select's terminal-click and empty-ground-clear branches unpinned (no scenario selects, then clicks empty ground/terminal)
detail: Junction and pipe selection are pinned, but the two clear branches never execute with a selection set — a regression that stops empty-ground clicks from clearing the selection (or lets terminal clicks fall through to pipes) passes the suite.
recommended_fix: Add scenarios: select a pipe then click empty ground (assert sel_pipe == -1); click a terminal (assert no pipe fall-through selection).

title: Advisory test gate: FAIL
evidence:
fmt.printf("  PASS input-parity   %d scenario(s) green — mouse == touch == controller (ODN-12 / FORGE #6)\n", green)
--- 17 scenarios in build_scenarios; the unpinned code paths above: app/input/mouse.odin:276 `phase2_blocked := has_right || (has_left && (ui || tray_hit || placing_eff >= 0))` (1/4 disjuncts pinned), exec.odin:66 Press_Anchor (unobservable), exec.odin:192 pad_alive guard (unexercised), controller.odin:68 Start (unpinned).
detail: P0 100% (draw/draw_wide blessed T1, select, demolish, place-happy, reject, QoS lane all non-vacuous). P1 ~50% excluding r1-tracked knowns (4 full, 7 partial, 5 none across the transcription branches); overall ~65%. P1 <80% and overall <80% -> FAIL.
recommended_fix: Wire on_ui_press/on_ui_release stubs in the harness; add same-frame phase-2 suppression, pad Start, demolished-cursor, placement-gate, and selection-clear scenarios; make the Press_Anchor, reject, and pan asserts observable.
